capabilities: Open files from the file explorer in new tabs
Activate the existing tab when a file is already open
Hijack file explorer clicks to change default open behavior
disambiguation: Only intercepts file explorer clicks; it does not apply to the quick switcher or other parts of Obsidian.
extras: The author describes the plugin as a hack with limited maintenance planned and recommends requesting the functionality natively from Obsidian; much of the README is developer build/release boilerplate.
intentEvidence: The way this plugin works is through hijacking the clicks for the file explorer.
problem: Clicking files in the file explorer reuses the current tab, and Obsidian has no native setting to open files in new tabs or avoid duplicate tabs.
summary: Tab-behavior patch that opens files clicked in the file explorer in new tabs and focuses the existing tab instead of duplicating it.
